text: Rwanda's Law N° 009/2021 of 16/02/2021 established the Rwanda Social Security Board (RSSB), and its supervising authority is Rwanda's Ministry in charge of finance. Ecofin Agency described RSSB as "a major public institution".
short: RSSB is a Rwandan state institution supervised by the Ministry in charge of finance

source.name: Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda: LAW N° 009/2021 OF 16/02/2021 establishing Rwanda Social Security Board
source.note: Articles 2 and 5: RSSB is established as a specialised organ; 'The supervising authority of RSSB is the Ministry in charge of finance.'
source.quote: The supervising authority of RSSB is the Ministry in charge of finance.

additionalSources.name: Ecofin Agency: Rwanda's RSSB Tigers hand country first continental basketball crown amid growing sports economy ambitions
additionalSources.quote: the club was taken over by the Rwanda Social Security Board (RSSB) in 2025 and rebranded as RSSB Tigers. The acquisition gave the club the backing of a major public institution
